searchText: Why are we focusing on stakers? They're kinda a niche group of our users How is the full node retirement going to be substantially smaller than the staker one? I think it's fine to get numbers on the validating node. But if just to follow the chain we need to have a dedicated computer in a first world country I may as well get a job in Solana or tempo Possibly because RPC nodes are not run by enthusiasts. I expect pros won't have an issue with bandwidth and CPU requirements. Point taken though: I can make the survey wider and ask whether it's an RPC node or staking node, and then ask for bandwidth, CPU and RAM Why RPCs and pros. My Bitcoin node ran for many years at 200GB Hdd and I could trustlessly send transactions. Stakers should be considered the pros here. Full nodes is what we should make sure can be run at home In the context of the CL, they are the ones who will be aggregating leanVM signatures and proofs, so the leanVM hardware requirements for the CL are based on that (this was/is the topic for this thread) I’m for it. I have yet to meet someone who does, though I am sure it happens But aggregating doesn't really affect much more bandwidth it's CPU bound, while the bottleneck we're talking about is bandwidth currently all nodes are supposed to gossip 2 attestation subnets, which with PQ would be roughly 1MB in and out per slot (or slightly less) x7 or so for gossip amplification. 7MB is 56Mbit. These don't arrive all at once, currently the majority typically arrive across 2-3s. So its conceivable that the bandwidth constraints will cause delays at least. Aggregates are global and they are 300KB each now Plus the CL block and the payload being each much larger yes - sorry I was thinking of the single attestations the aggregates are 300KB on each of 16 subnets with 16? aggregators per subnet, is 16x16x300KB is quite a lot of traffic x gossip duplication I think specing requirements for the staking machine as the minimum can only be valid if we had good light clients for users. Without a working solution for trustless access to the state we cannot arbitrarily require from a full node similar requirements than the staker They are talking about 4 aggregators instead which may lead to loss of attestations as a trade-off even in this case that is nearly 19MB without factoring in gossip amplification Yes, there's no good scenario for the P2P stack after PQ 😢 unless we prioritise networking changes Well I'm a bit lying though, DC does help a lot if not solve the issue for the full node. Full nodes can simply not care about P2P attestations and just take them from blocks So if we were to go with DC+PQ at least the profile from users and stakers may be quite different if we remove all the attestation+aggregation bandwidth from the former this: https://notes.ethereum.org/@cskiraly/seacast?stext=18688%3A120%3A0%3A1794652718%3AELIBFX ☝️ what this shows is that there is purely engineering solution that can reduce bandwidth use by 50% and have worst case delivery times 10x faster. A full node and a staking machine have different latency and resource requirements so they would have different minimums (this is why 7870 also separated the two) I don’t expect a normal full node to care about things like the intermediate aggregates that happen during consensus
